name: Waiting Bench
text: Gain +0 contract value. Whenever you leave a shop without buying a sigil, this sigil gains 10 contract value.

signature.effect: +10 per shop left without buying since purchase, max +40

decision: Shopping: skip a weak shop to build the count and save gold, or buy.
opponent: Visible count; no effect on opponents.
aiNote: Skip a shop when no offer is worth 10 points a round and the count is below +40.
rationale: A skip trades a common (about +12 a round) for a permanent +10 (+8 expected) plus saved gold and interest, an even trade that makes weak shops useful; with a full collection it keeps growing every shop, a late-run payoff for a finished build.
